metadata.title: Transcript provenance and normal-parent sequence comparisons for EMC fusion-junction antisense designs
metadata.description: Versioned computational inputs, source receipts, junction provenance, 40 design rows (35 source-linked and five hypothetical controls), 77 normal-parent transcript records, all exact match locations, sensitivity results and reproducible Python analysis. The study reconstructs USZ20 reference correspondence and preserves USZ22 ambiguity and a negative partial sequencing-data probe. These are sequence comparisons, not evidence of cleavage, potency, safety or clinical benefit. Original repository code retains Apache-2.0 licensing. Third-party sequence references retain their source attribution and applicable terms. Literature PDFs, abstracts and figures are linked in the source ledger rather than republished in this repository archive.
